basis: PRODUCT §4 keeps existing conversation cwd, permits draft location choice before send; §8 preserves Agent HOME/config/history and only Farfold metadata.

Active plan M explicitly requests optional existing/new worktree, ownership, recovery and safe cleanup. Explicit user-initiated fixed Git commands are Farfold file-management operations, not a second Agent loop.
Do not label directory separation an environment sandbox; Git objects/refs/config, Agent account and dependencies can remain shared.
contract.completionBoundary: Design and temporary Git probes do not close any M item or reduce 122-item/29×8 conditions. Creation/adoption is a first deliverable; safe archival/restoration/deletion remain required separate implementations.

currentSourceGaps.fact: Directory picker only updates still-current draft pair after await; preserve this ownership check for worktree result. No current worktree manager exists.
cwd currently canonicalized before official session open and process current_dir. New tree must enter this existing chain; no rewriting indexed existing cwd.
Work policy locks exact cwd; load/resume bypasses that policy intentionally. It is not a subtree maintenance barrier or ongoing-execution lock.
Current per-session restore/archive reservations and flush guards protect one indexed conversation, not every Agent/service/descendant path or external process in a tree.
Existing global activity/update/exit ownership can retain a Git operation across UI disappearance, but does not establish repository-path quiescence or external-process absence.

cases.meaning: Synthetic sleep process only, not an Agent.
post-command identity/OID check must detect drift; never auto-remove real created tree
frontend/backend must reject overlap when unsupported; Git does not enforce independent-location UX
identity and nofollow policy cannot rely on Git path spelling

observedGit.nonGitChild: One self-owned /bin/sleep3 held fixture cwd; directly waited and reaped. No Agent used.
criticalConclusions: Non-force worktree remove removed an ignored synthetic file: require explicit ignored-file inventory; Git clean/no-force is insufficient.
Non-force remove succeeded while a controlled child still held cwd: Git does not enforce Farfold busy admission.
Non-force remove deleted a clean tree with an unpublished commit but retained branch: preserved branch is not proof of remote backup.
post-checkout exit7 left real branch/tree/registration: nonzero/cancel/timeout cannot be classified as no-effect or auto-retried.
Git permits nested target and symlinked parent; explicit path identity/overlap policy must precede operation.
Existing branch tip changed after preview and add checked out new tip: compare selected OID immediately before and after, preserve result on mismatch.

minimumBackendInterface.name: inspectWorktree(path)
minimumBackendInterface.semantics: Readonly exact selected path; return main/linked/bare, canonical top/gitDir/commonDir identity, HEAD/OID/ref, lock/status/feature blockers. NUL-safe bounded official rev-parse and worktree list. Do not silently elevate imported tree to created ownership.

minimumBackendInterface.name: listWorktreeRefs(inspectToken,cursor)
minimumBackendInterface.semantics: Bounded local refs with exact OID and checked-out paths; no fetch/remote guessing. Reject invalid/new conflicting refs using check-ref-format; new branch uses explicit start OID.

minimumBackendInterface.name: prepareCreate / startCreate / operationStatus
minimumBackendInterface.semantics: Prepare validates nonoverlap, target absent, parent identity, supported checkout semantics and selected branch/OID. Persist single current intent with CAS before spawn. Start once with argv/no shell; exact process handle and bounded stdout/stderr; reap before terminal. Verify resulting Git registration, HEAD/ref/commonDir and OS object identity before ready. Unknown or nonzero preserves material and offers read-only recheck, never compensating rm/branch delete/retry.

minimumBackendInterface.name: adoptExisting / forgetListing
minimumBackendInterface.semantics: Adopt verifies existing linked tree and saves bounded metadata; forget changes only Farfold list. Existing tree receives no deletion ownership. UI applies ready cwd only to original unsent draft; late success stays manageable without switching or sending.

minimumBackendInterface.name: prepareArchive / archive / restore / prepareRemove / remove
minimumBackendInterface.semantics: Do not expose mutation until scoped maintenance lease covers create/load/restore/prompt and all affected native owners, saved/unsaved input, local page/service/file-copy operations. Recheck after flush and before official Git move/remove; keep lease across command/reap/CAS. Archive preserves directory with official same-volume move; restore requires exact old commonDir/registration/branch and vacant original path. Move is not an independent backup. Permanent removal needs separate explicit confirmation, ignored/untracked/nested/submodule/lock/unpushed/unknown checks; no force/prune/branch removal.

executionProfile: Use a verified absolute Git executable with fixed argv, not repo-provided executable or shell. Feature-probe supported commands; do not infer behavior from version string alone.

Per-command disable hooks and fsmonitor, no maintenance/autofetch/recurse; identify configured filters/sparse/partial/promisor/submodule/unsupported checkout before mutation. Unknown capabilities reject with existing-directory route; do not silently omit files or claim these gates implemented.
Do not change global/local Git config or Agent env/HOME. Probe used empty Git global/system config only in own synthetic child environment; not a proposed Agent environment change.

Bound process/output/time/resource ownership. A terminated process may have changed disk or left lock/registration; retain current intent and require explicit recheck. No automatic lock deletion or Git repair.

requiredAdmissionDesign.ownedActivity: Canonical roots and path descendants/aliases; cover all Agent/service connections including restored sessions, opening/closing/config/approval/unknown tail states. Idle local process must be closed through exact owner when necessary before moving its cwd. Stop/negative replies stay allowed.
requiredAdmissionDesign.savedInput: Flush and recheck composers/attachments/feedback/queues without enumerating bodies into logs; no cwd rewrite or automatic send.
requiredAdmissionDesign.externalActivity: No local connection is not external-idle proof. The current design has no OS-wide exclusion and cannot promise arbitrary concurrent editor/Agent safety. Do not enable destructive remove until concrete race/identity/unknown behavior is implemented and tested.
requiredAdmissionDesign.lockOrdering: Specify commonDir write serialization and path maintenance lease ordering before integration; avoid holding MetaStore mutex across subprocess wait.
requiredAdmissionDesign.recovery: Startup only reads intent and actual Git/OS identities. Same spelling, missing source, dual locations, re-added registration or changed refs cannot be guessed as completed; no automatic replay/repair.

backendIndependent: New dedicated temporary-repo tests; existing modules only small registered hooks after coordination.
backendSharedIntegration: Later browser/file/copy owners and draft_exit for archival/removal protection
frontendSharedIntegration: Management entry plus draft flush/persistence; existing session cwd unchanged.
suggestedOwnership.recommendedFirstSlice: inspect/local refs/explicit create or adopt/recheck + original draft selection, with hook/filter/network/unknown-result gates; leave actual recycle actions unexposed and H14/H15 pending until cross-owner maintenance admission is complete.

remainingUnproven: No Farfold API/UI/storage implementation or Agent busy test ran. Synthetic sleep only demonstrates Git does not protect a live cwd.
No filters/promisor/sparse/submodule lifecycle, Windows, huge repo/resource stress, disk-full/crash recovery, external-path race or OS-wide process exclusion tested.
Temporary command success proves these exact Apple Git2.39.5 fixtures only.
